t.zh: 到这里，每一步用哪条规则，都是你看过目标后选定的。引入规则看的是目标：目标是什么结构，就是哪条引入规则造出来的。设计出的证明助手会成为新元件「分解目标」。
t.en: Until now, the rule for each step was chosen by you after looking at the goals. Introduction rules look at the goal: a goal’s shape says which introduction rule made it. The proof assistant you design becomes a new part, “Goal apart”.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：用每一条对得上的引入规则把目标倒着拆一步，每种拆法都留下；一条都对不上时失败。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes the goal one step apart with every introduction rule that fits, keeping every way; when none fits, it fails.

hint.zh: 引入规则有六条：拼接、假设框、补充左右两条、任取框、概括。
hint.en: There are six introduction rules: Join, the assumption box, Add alternative left and right, the for-any box, and Generalise.
<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> can be set to six regions.
